result.summary: The project requires client acceptance with a 95% test pass rate. The Product Manager proposed a lower threshold of 90% for the pilot, but client approval has not been obtained. QA continues to use the 95% standard in the acceptance checklist. No schedule impact was discussed.

requirement_changes.requirement: Test pass rate for client acceptance
evidence: The Product Manager said that 90% would be acceptable for the pilot, but client approval has not been obtained.

uncertainties.item: Client approval for the 90% test pass rate
uncertainties.reason: Client approval has not been obtained for the proposed change to the test pass rate requirement.
uncertainties.needed_information: Client approval status for the 90% test pass rate.
